_label: Issue-data retention windows (S-147). Aligned with docs/RETENTION.md row 'Issue reports' (public record; reporter link removed on account deletion); the periods below are engineering proposals pending the same counsel sign-off as that table. Environment variables override each value.

notes.media_days: Encrypted photo/voice files are purged this many days after upload, and on account deletion (CIVIC_MEDIA_RETENTION_DAYS).
notes.gps_exact_days: The exact (unrounded) GPS point is kept only encrypted and internal, and is cleared after this many days; public display always uses the rounded point (CIVIC_GPS_EXACT_DAYS).
notes.ivr_call_state_minutes: Persisted IVR call state (encrypted caller number) is dropped after this long (TTL).
notes.unattached_media_hours: Uploads never attached to a report are removed after this long.
